stock.description: Yida China Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the development and operation of business parks throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's activities are organized into distinct segments. Its Property Development division focuses on constructing and selling various real estate assets. Through its Property Investment segment, the company acquires properties for rental purposes. Additionally, the Business Park Operation and Management unit delivers operational and administrative services to business park ventures owned by local authorities or other independent third parties. The Construction, Decoration, and Landscaping segment undertakes property construction, provides interior design services to property buyers, and offers landscaping for its projects. Yida China boasts a diverse real estate portfolio that includes integrated residential community projects featuring multiple functions, commercial office buildings, and standalone residential properties. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Shanghai, PRC.
